facts.fact: UIXP says it began and ended 2024 with 32 connected networks, including six at the Raxio carrier-neutral data centre, with its switching infrastructure operating reliably.

Traffic: approximately 40 Gbps (peak) at UIXP in 2024, the UIXP's own report for the year, with a mid-year dip after Google's remote peering ended and a rise in November when the Akamai cache was restored.
UIXP deployed a Netflix cache in 2024, reachable by connected networks through its route servers, with cache-fill donated by Lyca Mobile; Netflix also connected to UIXP as a new peer.
UIXP restored an Akamai cache to service on an experimental basis in 2024 (traffic boost in November), using cache-fill bandwidth donated by RENU.
UIXP names Meta among its larger peers, which made multi-year prepayments toward its endowment fund.

note: Google remote peering withdrawal in 2024 not recorded as a fact (not an exchange closure); city of UIXP not given.
